opportunities.name: Movie night invite from IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes
opportunities.description: Look up a movie on IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes, then draft a movie-night email to a friend with director, runtime, IMDb score and Tomatometer.
steps: Search the movie title on IMDb and open its page
Note director, runtime and IMDb rating
Search the same title on Rotten Tomatoes and open its page
Open mail compose and enter the recipient
Enter body with the movie details and scores

instances.values: The Grand Budapest Hotel, aisha@example.com, Sunday

opportunities.name: npm package stats note
opportunities.description: Search an npm package, open its page and GitHub releases, then save a note with version, weekly downloads, license, stars, open issues and last release date.
steps: Search the package name on npmjs
Note version, weekly downloads and license
Open Releases and note stars, open issues and last release date
Add a note in the notes app with the summary

opportunities.name: Recipe research note
opportunities.description: Search a recipe on Allrecipes, open it, look up the dish origin on Wikipedia, and save a note with servings, rating, time, ingredients and origin.
steps: Search the dish on Allrecipes and open the top recipe
Note rating, time and first ingredients
Search the dish on Wikipedia and note its origin
Add a note in the notes app: '<dish> for <n>: ... Origin: ...'
